name: PDK4
summary: PDK4, a straightforward speed gene: each A copy adds a small amount of movement speed and nothing else. It is one atomic locus, not a hidden bundle of markers.

phenotypes.name: PDK4 racing type
phenotypes.description: Two racing copies. The full speed bonus this locus offers.

phenotypes.name: PDK4 intermediate
phenotypes.description: One racing copy. Exactly half the bonus - the alleles add rather than one masking the other.

phenotypes.name: PDK4 wild type
phenotypes.description: No racing copy. No contribution to speed.
